atomic_units.criterion_text: \. Male or female subjects ≥ 18 years old.
atomic_units.violation_rationale: This value represents a subject who is almost 18 years old, making them clinically marginally ineligible.

atomic_units.criterion_text: Written informed consent approved by the Independent Ethics Committee (IEC), prior to the performance of any trial activities.
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0 or 1.
atomic_units.violation_rationale: An ECOG performance status of 2 indicates some degree of symptom and functional impairment, which is just outside the eligibility criteria.

atomic_units.threshold: transitional cell carcinoma of the urothelium
atomic_units.criterion_text: Histologically confirmed, unresectable locally advanced or metastatic transitional cell carcinoma of the urothelium.
Stage IV disease (T4b, N0, M0; any T, N1-N3, M0; any T, any N, M1) at the start of first line chemotherapy.

atomic_units.variable: Prior first-line chemotherapy must have consisted of
atomic_units.criterion_text: Prior first-line chemotherapy must have consisted of at least 4 cycles and no more than 6 cycles of gemcitabine plus cisplatin and/or gemcitabine plus carboplatin.
atomic_units.violation_rationale: This value is clinically marginal as it is just one cycle short of the minimum required for eligibility.

atomic_units.criterion_text: Patient inclusion within the trial must occur within 3-12 weeks after the last dose of chemotherapy (3-12 weeks treatment-free interval).
atomic_units.violation_rationale: This value is just slightly beyond the upper limit of the allowed treatment-free interval.

atomic_units.criterion_text: Only patients without progressive disease as per RECIST v1.1 guidelines after 4-6 cycles of chemotherapy will be allowed to be included. Baseline CT scan before inclusion should confirm that patients are on CR, PR or SD according to RECIST 1.1 criteria.
Tumor tissue (formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) archival or recent acquisition) must be available at baseline.

Note: Fine Needle Aspiration \[FNA\] and bone metastases samples are not acceptable. If an insufficient amount of tumor tissue from an unresectable or metastatic site is available prior to the start of the screening phase, subjects must consent to allow the acquisition of additional tumor tissue. This may be discussed with the PI if a new biopsy is feasible.
Haemoglobin ≥ 9.0 g/dL.
atomic_units.violation_rationale: This value is clinically marginal as it is just 0.1 g/dL below the required threshold for hemoglobin levels.

atomic_units.criterion_text: Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) \> 1500 per mm3.
atomic_units.violation_rationale: This value is clinically marginal as it is just slightly below the required threshold for adequate neutrophil count.

atomic_units.criterion_text: Platelet count ≥ 100,000 per mm3.
atomic_units.violation_rationale: This value is clinically marginal as it is just 0.1 below the required platelet count threshold.

atomic_units.criterion_text: Serum bilirubin ≤ 1.5 X institutional upper limit of normal (ULN) unless liver metastases are present, in which case it must be ≤ 2X ULN. This will not apply to patients with confirmed Gilbert's syndrome (persistent or recurrent hyperbilirubinemia that is predominantly unconjugated in the absence of haemolysis or hepatic pathology); however, they will be allowed only in consultation with their physician.
atomic_units.violation_rationale: This value is marginally above the threshold, representing a slight increase in bilirubin levels that could still be clinically relevant.

atomic_units.criterion_text: Serum transaminases (ALT, AST and GGT) ≤ 2.5X institutional upper limit of normal unless liver metastases are present, in which case it must be ≤ 3X ULN.
atomic_units.violation_rationale: This value is clinically marginal as it is just 0.1 units above the upper limit for eligibility.

atomic_units.criterion_text: Measured creatinine clearance (CL) \> 30 mL/min or Calculated creatinine CL \> 40 mL/min by the Cockcroft-Gault formula (Cockcroft and Gault 1976) or by 24-hour urine collection for the determination of creatinine clearance.
atomic_units.violation_rationale: This value is clinically marginal as it is just below the threshold required for eligibility.

atomic_units.variable: Female subjects of childbearing potential (WOCBP) must provide a negative urine pregnancy test at screening, and must agree to use a medically accepted and highly effective birth control method (i.e. those with a failure rate
atomic_units.criterion_text: Female subjects of childbearing potential (WOCBP) must provide a negative urine pregnancy test at screening, and must agree to use a medically accepted and highly effective birth control method (i.e. those with a failure rate less than 1%; refer to ANNEX III) for the duration of the study treatment and for 5 months after the last dose of study treatment.
atomic_units.violation_rationale: This value is just outside the boundary of the requirement for highly effective birth control methods with a failure rate less than 1%, indicating an increased risk of pregnancy.

atomic_units.criterion_text: A woman is considered of childbearing potential ( i.e. fertile) following menarche and until becoming post-menopausal unless permanently sterile. Women will be considered post-menopausal if they have been amenorrhoeic for 12 months without an alternative medical cause. The following age-specific requirements apply:
Amenorrheic for ≥1 year in the absence of chemotherapy and/or hormonal treatments
atomic_units.violation_rationale: This value reflects a duration of amenorrhea just under the one-year requirement, which could result from variations in menstrual cycles.

atomic_units.criterion_text: Luteinizing hormone (LH) and/or follicle stimulating hormone and/or estradiol levels in the post-menopausal range
atomic_units.violation_rationale: This value is clinically marginal as it is just below the lower limit of the post-menopausal range for luteinizing hormone.

atomic_units.variable: Radiation induced oophorectomy with last menses \
atomic_units.criterion_text: Radiation induced oophorectomy with last menses \>1 year ago
atomic_units.violation_rationale: Having the last menses exactly 1 year ago is clinically marginally outside the criterion of >1 year.

atomic_units.criterion_text: Chemotherapy induced menopause with \>1 year interval since last menses
atomic_units.violation_rationale: A value of 0.9 years indicates less than the required 1 year since last menses, reflecting a threshold breach that is marginal yet non-compliant.

atomic_units.criterion_text: Surgical sterilization (bilateral oophorectomy or hysterectomy)

Women \<50 years of age would be considered post-menopausal if they have been amenorrheic for 12 months or more following cessation of exogenous hormonal treatments and if they have luteinizing hormone and follicle-stimulating hormone levels in the post-menopausal range for the institution or underwent surgical sterilization (bilateral oophorectomy or hysterectomy)
atomic_units.violation_rationale: This value is clinically marginal as it represents the smallest age increment above the threshold for eligibility.

atomic_units.criterion_text: Women ≥50 years of age would be considered post-menopausal if they have been amenorrheic for 12 months or more following cessation of all exogenous hormonal treatments, or underwent surgical sterilization (bilateral oophorectomy, bilateral salpingectomy or hysterectomy).
atomic_units.violation_rationale: An age of 49 represents the smallest increment below the post-menopausal threshold, making the individual ineligible yet only slightly below the requirement.

atomic_units.criterion_text: ECOG performance status of \>1 (Karnofsky \< 70%).
atomic_units.violation_rationale: An ECOG score of 2 indicates a worse performance status, representing a very marginal increase in deterioration from the threshold of 1.

atomic_units.criterion_text: Patients whose disease progressed by RECIST v1.1 on or after first-line chemotherapy for urothelial cancer in the advanced or metastatic setting.

atomic_units.variable: Note: Patients may have received immunotherapy in the adjuvant setting as long as the last dose of adjuvant was administered
atomic_units.criterion_text: Note: Patients may have received immunotherapy in the adjuvant setting as long as the last dose of adjuvant was administered at least 12 months prior to the first dose of trial treatment.
atomic_units.violation_rationale: This value is clinically marginal as it represents a last dose just below the required 12 months threshold.

atomic_units.criterion_text: Receipt of any type of systemic chemotherapy or anticancer therapy within 3 weeks before starting treatment.
atomic_units.violation_rationale: Receiving treatment 2.9 weeks prior is clinically marginal as it is just close enough to the threshold to potentially influence treatment outcomes.

atomic_units.criterion_text: Previously identified allergy or hypersensitivity to components of the study treatment formulations.

atomic_units.variable: time since non-cancer treatment with vaccines
atomic_units.criterion_text: Any non-cancer treatment with vaccines used for the prevention of infectious diseases (up to 1 month before or after any dose of ipilimumab and nivolumab).
Major surgery (i.e. cystectomy) less than 28 days prior to the first dose of study treatment.

atomic_units.criterion_text: Patients with known symptomatic central nervous system (CNS) metastases requiring steroids.
